rows.en: The Neo-Human Empire…
The same Neo-Human blood as mine flows in your veins, too.

…!?

Stop it, Mom!!

Ba~ra, barabarabanbaaa!

Goro Watari, grant your mother's wish! And even if you won't, you're a Neo-Human with the same blood as ours. Goro, become our comrade!
Ridiculous… Don't talk such nonsense!
Goro!
Besides… there's no telling whether this thing is even my mother!

…!?

Damn… Neo-Humans! Where did Goro go?

…!?

Damn… Neo-Humans! Where could Goro have gone?

Fufufu… How suspicious you are!

Bara Banbara! Show him that you're the real thing!

First, the pendant! Put it together with yours and it should form a rose!
The pendant?
Here, Goro… take this.
It fits perfectly… Is this really Mom's?
Now do you understand, Goro Watari… Your mother is a Neo-Human! Our comrade, a Neo-Human!

…No!

This person isn't my mother! My mother died 15 years ago! Besides…
…Besides? What is it, Goro Watari?
She should have a "rose-shaped birthmark" on her left arm, just like mine…
Goro…

…!?

That birthmark…? Then… it really is you, Mom!?
Well? Do you still intend to kill your own mother!?
Goro…
Goro…
Goro…
Goro…
Goro…
Goro…
Goro…

Ba~ra, barabarabanbaaa!

Goro Watari isn't coming to save you! Goro Watari has joined the Neo-Human Empire!
What!? Don't screw with me!! Goro isn't that kind of guy!
What!? Don't screw with me!! Goro isn't that kind of guy!
No!? Goro, a Neo-Human? That can't be…
No!? Goro, a Neo-Human? That can't be…
What did you say!? Don't screw with me!! Goro isn't that kind of person!
What did you say!? Don't screw with me!! Goro isn't that kind of person!
Liar!? There's no way Goro would become a Neo-Human!
Liar!? There's no way Goro would become a Neo-Human!
It's no lie! Look!
Ridiculous!? I don't believe it… Goro!
Ridiculous!? I don't believe it… Goro!
It can't be!? That's a lie, isn't it? Goro…
It can't be!? That's a lie, isn't it? Goro…
Ridiculous!? I don't believe it, Goro!
Ridiculous!? I don't believe it, Goro!
It's a lie, right… Goro?
It's a lie, right… Goro?
Goro!
Goro!
Goro!
Goro!
Goro!
Goro!
Goro!
Die in despair! Ba~ra, barabarabanbaaa!

Mom… What should I do?

Am I to fight you to save [HERO2] and the others?

Tell me! Please, tell me!! Mom!!
"Goro… help… me…"
That's… Mom's voice…
"…I was captured and turned into a Neo-Human against my will. Goro, help me! Gorooo!!"

…!?

That's it! Mom didn't become a Neo-Human of her own free will!

They forced a command circuit or something into her body! I have to save Mom… and [HERO2] and the others too!
Stop it, Mom! Go back to being the kind mother you were 15 years ago!
[VAR6]… Goro…

Here, look at this pendant!

Have you forgotten? I'm Goro! Your son, Goro! Please remember!
…!? Aaaaaah!!
Mom!!
Go… Goro……

Curse you, Bara Banbara! Now that you've regained a human heart… I have no further use for you!

Die, Bara Banbara!
Mom!?
"Go… ro…"

Mom! Mom!!

Damn you… Banba!!
Ba~ra, barabarabanbaaa!

What!?

Dr. Araki got away before you got the blueprints?

Please wait… Professor Gill!

Dr. Araki has decided to cooperate with the TDF… Even Emperor Banba's Phantom Army can no longer easily lay a hand on him.

What!? Araki has gone over to the TDF?

Nngh… so the Phantom Army has outlived its usefulness?

Well, no matter… We may have joined hands for a time, but I never counted on them!

Kaimen Green! So… where are the blueprints?

Surely… they haven't fallen into the TDF's hands?
Mom…
Mom…
The mother he had thought dead was alive. But even that fleeting joy was cruelly scattered in an instant…
Even so, Goro Watari cannot drown himself in grief. For starting tomorrow, days of battle await him once again…

I'll fight…

so that people living in peace never have to suffer the way we have…

I'll fight, and fight… and fight to the very end!
Defeat the Rose Monster and all Phantom Soldiers and rescue Dr. Araki! However, if the Rose Monster seizes the laboratory, Dr. Araki will die!
